headline: Liverpool 0-3 Manchester City: Premier League – as it happened
body: City embraced a hostile atmosphere and overwhelmed Liverpool after Ryan Gravenberch’s red card An update from Will Unwin, who is part of our team at Anfield for today’s game A group of over 600 Manchester City fans were given a police escort across Stanley Park, chanting as they went about their owners and throwing abuse back at any Liverpool fans who took issue. The message was a clear one of defiance from the hardcore away support. Crystal Palace 3-1 Nottingham Forest Hull City 2-2 Everton Continue reading...
